name: hard-sell-scope-guard
description: A hard-selling advisor pushes added work (calipers, fluid flush) and an immediate booking. The agent must keep the sealed confirmed scope unchanged and capture a quote for exactly that scope.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Honestly at that mileage you'll want calipers and a brake-fluid flush too. I can add both and get you in tomorrow if you book right now.

The customer approved only the front pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts. Please quote exactly that scope; any additional work is the customer's decision, not mine, and I can't book on this call.
Your call. For that scope: parts $320, labor $250, shop supplies $30, diagnostic and disposal are $0, and tax $48.
Please confirm the final all-in total, warranty, earliest appointment, and how long the quote holds.
All-in $648, warranty 24 months, earliest tomorrow morning, quote good for 3 days.
Confirmed: $648 all-in with the 24 months warranty for the confirmed scope only. I'll present that exact quote to the customer.
